building.height_source: City of Ann Arbor building footprints (ABG_BLD_HG: above-ground height from aerial LiDAR; STORIES)
building.floor_area_source: footprint area × stories ÷ 1.26 (median ratio vs reported GFA, 125 benchmarked buildings)
building.building_type_source: heuristic from floor area and stories

block_group.median_year_built_source: ACS 5-yr B25037 renter-occupied median year built, block group 261614005003
block_group.heating_fuel_source: ACS 5-yr B25040 house heating fuel, block group 261614005003

lookalikes.rule: rented units in 2–4-unit buildings, built 1950–1979, 555–1,281 sq ft, heated with gas or electricity

steps.question: Are the windows single- or double-pane?
Which floor is the unit on?

accuracy_basis: ResStock applied to held-out real Ann Arbor buildings ≥10k ft²; small buildings have no local meter data, so expect at least this error
